# Headliner Console Switch Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Remove headliner assembly and install console switch using nut spacers for depth. [t4]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Remove the headliner assembly by pulling it down from the windshield/sunglasses holder side first.
2. Disconnect and unscrew the existing microphone mount, then cut a hole in its back with a mini blade saw attached to a Dremel.

_Procedure reported by [t4]._

## Tools

- Mini blade saw [t4]
- Dremel tool [t4]

## Parts

- Aluminum plate, 4 3/4" x 2 1/4" [t4]
- Illuminated Duckbill Toggle Switches [t4]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use nuts as spacers under the aluminum mounting plate to achieve proper switch depth. [t4]
